i.norm:
Verifies that {@link CharSetUtils#squeeze(String, String...)} collapses runs of repeated characters when those characters belong to the supplied set.

The character set contains the letter 'f'. In the input, only the word "offset" has a repeated character in the set ("ff"), so that run is squeezed to a single 'f' ("ofset"). All other characters are left untouched.
Set-syntax characters to squeeze; includes 'f', the only repeated char in the input. The array has trailing null entries, which CharSetUtils ignores.
